# Awesome Jev use cases

> Unofficial, open-source (CC0) list of things built with TypeSafe AI's Jev model, a System One decision model that returns typed answers (Choice, Score, Noul) instead of text. Includes 74 demo posts ranked by likes, 150+ GitHub repos, limits, cost, an API quickstart and keyword research. Sponsored by AY Automate.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/walidboulanouar/awesome-jev-use-cases/blob/main/README.md): the full list
- [API quickstart](https://github.com/walidboulanouar/awesome-jev-use-cases/blob/main/docs/api-quickstart.md): curl example and rules
- [Keyword research](https://github.com/walidboulanouar/awesome-jev-use-cases/blob/main/docs/keyword-research.md): what people search for
- [Search plan](https://github.com/walidboulanouar/awesome-jev-use-cases/blob/main/docs/search-plan.md): how this repo is meant to be found
